requiredFindings.title: The name-cost coefficient uses a byte limit the law does not impose
requiredFindings.detail: The per-listed-entry type prices owned(name bytes) with names at most 255 bytes. M3-C item 2 instead permits 255 Unicode scalars per segment; such a UTF-8 name can exceed 255 bytes. The existing walker explicitly uses MAX_COMPONENT_BYTES = 1023, and invalid raw names also require charged capture before their eventual Name refusal. Therefore the proposed coefficient is not an upper bound for every listed entry. An exact optimizer and a 2x multiplier cannot establish the claimed maximum when its input cost bound is wrong.
requiredFindings.requiredChange: Derive name/path byte envelopes from the actual platform observation limits and the logical scalar limits at their respective stages, including invalid names retained for an escaped refusal. Price actual byte copies and classification temporaries with those envelopes. Add multibyte 255-scalar and oversized/raw-name model controls and a mutant restoring the 255-byte assumption. Feed the corrected bounds into the exact solver before accepting the cap.

requiredFindings.title: The payload guard still changes walk-phase observations and needs a law decision
requiredFindings.detail: Q4 cannot be answered yes from item 2's payload-volume sentence alone. LD-C1A-10 stops content reads but claims every walk-phase refusal is preserved by continuing opens and metadata samples. A later file can open and have stable metadata while its Read operation would fail; the guard suppresses that read failure and instead reaches SnapshotBound. It likewise omits the actual read interval whose metadata comparison normally detects ChangedDuringRead. Samples around no read do not prove observational equivalence to the law's walk/read phase. The quoted 8 GiB admission bound does not specify this replacement algorithm or its failure precedence.
requiredFindings.requiredChange: Obtain an explicit M3-C clarification or amendment authorizing the over-volume incomplete-capture state, the observations skipped, and the resulting refusal precedence before implementing LD-C1A-10. Define bounded actual-byte handling for a file that grows or whose stat size is stale, and ensure no partial capture can seal. Include mixed-error controls with a later content-read I/O failure and changes during the would-be read, in addition to custody/open failures. Alternatively remove the optimization and retain the currently authorized walk semantics.
